	max_instances = 1
}

fumongus_init_01 = {
	class = "rl_standard_stars"
	usage = misc_system_init
	usage_odds = {
			base = @spawn_system_common
			inline_script = "solar_system_initializers/initializer_modifiers_habitable_world_systems"
		}
	max_instances = 1
	flags = { fumongus_system hostile_system }
	init_effect = { }
}

ghost_ship_system_initializer_01 = {
	class = "rl_standard_stars"
	usage = misc_system_init
	usage_odds = {
			base = @spawn_system_verycommon
			complex_trigger_modifier = {
				trigger = check_galaxy_setup_value
				parameters = {
				  setting = habitable_worlds_scale
				}
				mode = factor
				mult = 0.4 # e.g. 0.5x habitable = factor of 0.2; 5x habitable worlds = factor of 2
			}
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				has_star_flag = empire_cluster
			}
		}
	max_instances = 1
	planet = {
		init_effect = {
			create_country = { name = "NAME_Hillos_fleet" type = neutral_faction }
		}
	}
}

special_init_07 = {
	class = "rl_standard_stars"
	usage = misc_system_init
	usage_odds = {
			base = @spawn_system_common
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				NOT = { is_in_cluster = resource_cluster_1 }
			}
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				has_star_flag = empire_cluster
			}
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				is_bottleneck_system = yes
			}
		}
	max_instances = 1
	flags = { hostile_system space_ecology_system }
}

		}

the_chosen_home_initializer = {
	class = sc_g
	flags = {
			chosen_system
			crisis_spawn_exclude
		}
	usage = misc_system_init
	usage_odds = 0
	init_effect = {
		create_country = { name = "NAME_The_Chosen" type = default }
		spawn_system = { initializer = the_chosen_escapee_initializer }
		spawn_system = { initializer = the_chosen_resources_initializer }
		spawn_system = { initializer = random }
	}
}

the_chosen_resources_initializer = {
	class = rl_standard_stars
	flags = {
			chosen_system
			crisis_spawn_exclude
		}
	usage = misc_system_init
	usage_odds = 0

		spawn_system = { initializer = the_chosen_resources_initializer2 }
	}
}

	}
